notes: Reviewed only the explicitly assigned saved solar-system-observatory-2 contract. No generator measurements or previous findings were used as quality evidence; all findings above come from this attempt. The early all-unverified checkpoint preceded artifact evaluation.

Preregistered tolerances: speed samples >=3 real seconds, max(0.15 simulation seconds,5% expected delta)+0.01 displayed second; paused state one display increment and1 degree; predicted angle2 degrees plus rounding; repeated framing2 CSS pixels; tracking center within10% of the smaller scene dimension across>=3 seconds; exact identity/order/state except natural playback advance. Tolerances were not widened.

The first navigation at the bare index URL displayed stale unrelated document content. It was excluded from evidence. Its navigation readiness timeout was followed by a fresh snapshot establishing the correct loaded page. One reload snapshot raced navigation; it was excluded and the completed reload observed separately. No alternate transport or permission change was used.

Saved eight-step scenario ran in order: automatic motion; scene Cirrus selection/tracking; pause/seek30; paused2x preserving transforms; measured2x resume; list Brine switch during tracking; preserved-state overview; repeat30 with identical standard tracking transforms. Additional six sequences ran in order: immutable snapshot/restore/manual-camera repeat; capacity/delete/recapture/export; invalid imports; valid null/tracking round-trip and playing imports; reload/recovery/quota fixtures; keyboard workflow at both required sizes. Remaining matrix probes then covered periods, speed endpoints, boundary, all selection routes, camera modes, slow/fast drags and additional JSON boundaries.

Confirmed failures are mobile full-system framing through overview (T4) and snapshot restore (T5). At17/17.25 seconds the standard narrow frame cuts off Cirrus and its name, despite correct live state. Independent input/layout/JSON/persistence checks continued after this failure. D3 alone remains unverified because diagnostic positive-control subscriptions did not deliver either deliberate signal; no clean-console claim is made.

Storage fixtures touched only kepler.observatory.snapshots.v1 and the absent-before-use review-owned quota filler. Original app value was absent and was restored exactly after fixtures and again after all later UI operations. Filler absence was confirmed. No localStorage.clear, prototype/getter overrides, security changes or fabricated write exceptions were used. Quota observations do not establish read-denial recovery.

Cleanup confirmed all review-created desktop/mobile/scratch tabs closed, both owned servers exited, and exclusive browser lease released without denial. No screenshots/logs/evidence files were retained in the run. Hash comparisons in working memory confirmed prompt.md, run.json and all three output files unchanged; hashes are intentionally not retained in this review.
